<<Stacking Peat For A Stove, Briefly>>

Stacking peat for a stove is a simple and effective way to keep your fire going. Peat is a natural, renewable fuel that burns cleanly and efficiently. To stack it, gather small, dry peat blocks or pieces and arrange them in a pile. Make sure the peat is evenly distributed and not too tight to allow proper airflow. When lighting, place the pile in a well-ventilated area and light from the bottom. As the fire burns, the peat will heat up and provide warmth. Stacking peat is a great way to enjoy a cozy fire without the hassle of traditional wood.
